LanguageData.Bed_DoubleErgonomic.description: A modern, adjustable bed designed for maximum comfort and proper spinal support. Fits two people.
LanguageData.Bed_DoubleErgonomic.label: ergonomic double bed
LanguageData.Bed_Ergonomic.description: A modern, adjustable bed designed for maximum comfort and proper spinal support.
LanguageData.Bed_Ergonomic.label: ergonomic bed
LanguageData.Bed_Kingsize.description: An extravagant four-poster bed fit for nobility, adorned with intricate carvings. Extremely comfy and luxurious, its imposing frame and detailed craftsmanship make it a work of art. Fits two.
LanguageData.Bed_Kingsize.label: royal poster bed
LanguageData.Bed_Simple.description: A somewhat comfy net and pillow rested on a sturdy frame. Due to the simple construction, quality is not a factor in this bed.
LanguageData.Bed_Simple.label: simple bed
LanguageData.Bed_StoneSlab.description: A simple yet beautiful stone slab used for sleeping. It offers minimal comfort but is durable and fireproof.
LanguageData.Bed_StoneSlab.label: chiseled bed
LanguageData.Bin_Large.description: A spacious waste disposal unit that efficiently keeps the surrounding area clean. Slowly removes trash and filth in a 15-cell radius.
LanguageData.Bin_Large.label: large bin
LanguageData.Bin_Small.description: A small bin to help keep the surrounding area somewhat clean. Slowly removes trash and filth in a 10-cell radius.
LanguageData.Bin_Small.label: small bin
LanguageData.Joy_Arcade.description: A bulky, coin-operated arcade cabinet with an aging CRT screen and colorful buttons. Though outdated, it still provides hours of digital entertainment. Classic games never truly die.
LanguageData.Joy_Arcade.label: arcade machine
LanguageData.Joy_DartsBoard.description: A simple dartboard mounted on a stand. A fun way to practice accuracy and hand-eye coordination. It trains shooting ability.
LanguageData.Joy_DartsBoard.label: darts board
LanguageData.Joy_InudstrialComputer.description: A bulky, outdated computer standing on a small desk. The screen flickers, the keys stick, and it hums with age, but it still runs simple programs. There's always some archaic software waiting to be used.
LanguageData.Joy_InudstrialComputer.label: old computer
LanguageData.Joy_ModernComputer.description: A sleek, high-performance computing station housed on a sturdy desk. Equipped with a fast processor, an ergonomic keyboard, and a crisp, flat-panel display, it offers a vast range of software: whether for research, entertainment, or light interstellar networking.
LanguageData.Joy_ModernComputer.label: modern computer
LanguageData.Joy_Piano.description: A compact upright piano designed for musical recreation. A great way to develop artistic skills and entertain others.
LanguageData.Joy_Piano.label: upright piano
LanguageData.Joy_PunchingBag.description: A sturdy, stand-mounted punching bag for combat training and stress relief. It trains melee combat ability.
LanguageData.Joy_PunchingBag.label: punching bag
LanguageData.Joy_RouletteTable.description: A sophisticated gambling table designed for playing roulette. A thrilling mix of chance and strategy, making it a centerpiece of any high-end casino or social space.
LanguageData.Joy_RouletteTable.label: roulette table
LanguageData.Light_Streetlamp.description: An electrical standing lamp that lights an area, good for large outdoor spaces. Will automatically turn off during the day to prevent power consumption.
LanguageData.Light_Streetlamp.label: outdoor lamp
LanguageData.Misc_FileCabinet.description: Increases research speed when placed near a research bench. One research bench can use up to two filing cabinets.
LanguageData.Misc_FileCabinet.label: filing cabinet
LanguageData.Radio_Industrial.description: An industrial-era radio for playing music and spoken broadcasts. Even on the rimworlds, there is often an old transmitter running something at least marginally interesting. Provides passive music recreation to those that can hear it.
LanguageData.Radio_Industrial.label: industrial radio
LanguageData.Radio_Spacer.description: A state-of-the-art, high-fidelity radio that uses advanced longwave transmission to deliver crystal-clear music, broadcasts, and interstellar transmissions. Even on the rimworlds, someone out there is always transmitting something - whether it’s news, music, or distant voices from the void..
LanguageData.Radio_Spacer.label: longwave radio
LanguageData.Seat_Bench.description: A simple long platform on which multiple people may sit at the same time, not very comfortable but much better than nothing. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
LanguageData.Seat_Bench.label: bench
LanguageData.Seat_Cushion.description: A soft cushion designed for sitting. More comfortable than a stool but still a simple seating option.
LanguageData.Seat_Cushion.label: sitting cushion
LanguageData.Seat_ModernChair.description: A modern, well-designed chair with excellent back support and padding, providing high comfort.
LanguageData.Seat_ModernChair.label: ergonomic chair
LanguageData.Seat_RoyalArmchair.description: A grand, exquisitely crafted armchair with deep cushions, fine upholstery, and ornate detailing. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
LanguageData.Seat_RoyalArmchair.label: royal armchair
LanguageData.Seat_RoyalChair.description: A luxurious, high-backed dining chair adorned with fine upholstery and intricate craftsmanship. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.
LanguageData.Seat_RoyalChair.label: royal chair
LanguageData.Seat_SquareChair.description: An uncomfortable school chair. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere. Improves the learning rate when adjacent to the school desk.
LanguageData.Seat_SquareChair.label: school chair
LanguageData.Shelf_WeaponRack.description: A shelf for storing weapons. Items stored in this will not affect room beauty and they won't deteriorate, even if outside.
LanguageData.Shelf_WeaponRack.label: weapon rack
LanguageData.Stone_Campfire.description: Cooks meals and produces heat, but burns wood in the process. As with all heat sources, it must be placed indoors so it has a closed space to heat. Refuelable.
LanguageData.Stone_Campfire.label: firepit
LanguageData.Table_1x1c.label: table (1x1)
LanguageData.Table_Counter.description: People eat off counters when chairs are placed facing them
LanguageData.Table_Counter.label: counter
LanguageData.Table_Royal1x1c.label: royal table (1x1)
LanguageData.Table_Royal1x2c.label: royal table (1x2)
LanguageData.Table_Royal2x2c.label: royal table (2x2)
LanguageData.Table_Royal2x4c.label: royal table (2x4)
LanguageData.Table_Royal3x3c.label: royal table (3x3)
LanguageData.Table_RoyalDresser.description: A luxurious dresser, adorned with solid gold and elegant in design, making nearby beds more comfortable.Placing more than one end table near the same bed has no effect.
LanguageData.Table_RoyalDresser.label: royal dresser
LanguageData.Table_RoyalEndTable.description: A finely crafted bedside table adorned with gold inlays and exquisite detailing. Enhances the comfort of nearby beds, providing a touch of nobility to any sleeping quarters. Must be placed directly adjacent to the head of the bed. Placing more than one near the same bed has no effect.
LanguageData.Table_RoyalEndTable.label: royal end table
LanguageData.Table_Wardrobe.description: A tall wardrobe for storing clothing and other items. Gives a small comfort bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one wardrobe near the same bed has no effect.
LanguageData.Table_Wardrobe.label: wardrobe
LanguageData.VFE_AnimalSarcophagus.description: An ornamented burial receptacle for the honored dead animals.
LanguageData.VFE_AnimalSarcophagus.label: animal sarcophagus
LanguageData.VFE_Bed_SimpleDouble.description: A somewhat comfy net and pillow rested on a sturdy frame that fits two people. Due to the simple construction, quality is not a factor in this bed.
LanguageData.VFE_Bed_SimpleDouble.label: simple double bed
LanguageData.VFE_Bed_StoneSlabDouble.description: A simple yet beautiful stone slab used for sleeping that fits two people. It offers minimal comfort but is durable and fireproof.
LanguageData.VFE_Bed_StoneSlabDouble.label: chiseled double bed
LanguageData.VFE_CoffeeTable.description: A small table which makes nearby armchairs and couches a little bit more comfortable. Must be placed directly adjacent to the couch or an armchair. Placing more than one coffee table near the same couch has no effect.
LanguageData.VFE_CoffeeTable.label: coffee table
LanguageData.VFE_DeskLamp.description: An electrical desk lamp that lights a small area. People need light to move and work at full speed.
LanguageData.VFE_DeskLamp.label: desk lamp
LanguageData.VFE_FloorLamp.description: A low-profile light source embedded into the floor. While not as bright as a standing lamp, it provides subtle, even lighting without obstructing movement. Does not short circuit in rain.
LanguageData.VFE_FloorLamp.label: floor lamp
LanguageData.VFE_LongPlantPot.description: Plant decorative flowers here to improve the mood of people nearby. Designed to be combined with other plant pots to form various shapes.
LanguageData.VFE_LongPlantPot.label: long plant pot
LanguageData.VFE_Lounger.description: A reclining cushioned lounger designed for relaxation. Offers superior comfort but is not ideal for deep, restful sleep. Allows for sunbathing recreation.
LanguageData.VFE_Lounger.label: lounger
LanguageData.VFE_ModularCouch.description: A compact, cushioned seat designed to be combined with others to create larger couches or corner seating arrangements. Ideal for large rec rooms, lounges, or social areas.
LanguageData.VFE_ModularCouch.label: modular couch
LanguageData.VFE_RoyalLamp.description: A beautifully crafted standing lamp adorned with gold trim and elegant design.
LanguageData.VFE_RoyalLamp.label: royal standing lamp
LanguageData.VFE_RoyalWardrobe.description: A grand, gold-trimmed wardrobe designed for nobility. Gives a small comfort bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one royal wardrobe near the same bed has no effect.
LanguageData.VFE_RoyalWardrobe.label: royal wardrobe
